rules: bad: Not allowed here; rezoning needed. Zone BE does not permit Major Industrial for a new building, and the City treats large-scale data centres as Major Industrial (no size threshold given, so the tool applies it to every data centre): rezoning needed (register edm_dc_major). The numbers below use BE's own limits, for comparison only. Shown as if rezoned: a flagged option, not a prediction.

note: Loading: 1 bay inside the building (41 m² of ground storey; Architecture default, as the test fits draw it). Ratios takes this floor out of the ground; Arrange draws it on the ground storey at the rear end of the building (drawing choice).

bad: Data centre: its share (27%) leaves too little ground for the picked programs beside the hall. Back in Ratios it takes at most 2%.
